sentences: With diabetes, a wound takes longer to heal.
That includes the wound from surgery.
A long incision means more skin to mend, and more chance of infection while it does.
Minimal access surgery uses a few small openings instead of one long cut.
A camera and fine instruments do the work inside.
For suitable procedures, it can mean less pain, a smaller wound to heal, lower risk of wound infection and a shorter hospital stay.
A smaller wound gives slow healing less to repair.
Before any procedure, our team reviews your blood sugar, medicines and general health.
Your surgeon then tells you whether minimal access surgery suits your case.
Ava Consultants and Urology Centre, off the Four-Lane, Uyo.
